topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture structure, learning objectives, and the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and evasion of inhibitory signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in membrane receptor and downstream signaling pathways drive cell-autonomous proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Blocks to terminal differentiation in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how halting normal terminal differentiation maintains progenitor cells in a proliferative state across hematopoietic and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis, replicative immortality, and p53 stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells bypass intrinsic growth-limiting barriers such as programmed cell death and telomere-induced senescence through p53-regulated pathways.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells rewire cellular bioenergetics towards aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations drive epigenetic and transcriptional deregulation.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascular recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how developing tumors overcome oxygen and nutrient diffusion limits by inducing new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the sequential biological barriers, clinical tracking methods, microenvironmental interactions, and genomic features underlying metastatic dissemination.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides final summary thoughts and concludes the lecture.
